rttModel.estimator: RttEstimator: 32-sample window, smoothed (alpha 1/8) + jitter (beta 1/4), outlier = > 3*smoothed + 4*jitter + 20 ms (kept in the window, not folded), re-seed after 3 consecutive outliers, rejects <= 0 and > 60 s, stale after 30 s

rttSampleBounds: 32-sample window; samples <= 0 or > 60 s rejected; stale after 30 s; outlier > 3*smoothed + 4*jitter + 20 ms kept out of the estimate; live: 1805 samples/1805 markers answered in one session, 0 rejected, 0 late/unknown
